claims.claim: Rubrik Q2 FY2027 subscription ARR grew 33% to $1.66B, revenue grew 38% to $427.3M, and management raised all guided FY2027 metrics.
Rubrik launched Apache Iceberg protection on AWS in September 2026, extending resilience coverage into lakehouse data used by analytics and AI workloads.

factors.name: cyber resilience demand
factors.basis: ARR and revenue growth remained above 30% while guidance increased.

factors.name: AI/data platform adjacency
factors.basis: New Iceberg protection expands the addressable resilience surface around AI-ready enterprise data.

risks.risk: GAAP loss persists and rapid product expansion raises integration/execution complexity.

unknowns.unknown: Incremental revenue attributable to newer agentic/AI and Iceberg products is not separately disclosed.

claims.claim: Q2 FY2027 results exceeded guided metrics; subscription ARR contribution margin improved to 14.0% from 9.4%, operating cash flow margin was 18%, and free-cash-flow margin was 15%.

factors.name: operating leverage
factors.basis: Contribution and cash-flow margins improved while ARR and revenue continued rapid growth.

risks.risk: High growth expectations create execution sensitivity if net-new ARR or cloud growth decelerates materially.

unknowns.unknown: No canonical valuation conclusion is made by Scout.
